pages.title: Thirty Sects
pages.text: Each of the 30 playable sects has a unique stage-bound method grant, own-hall discount, mission contribution increment and specialty skill practice. Existing members are backfilled on sync while all method gates remain server-authoritative.

pages.title: Contribution Shops
pages.text: Each contribution token redeems one point. Displayed hall prices match server debit; foreign halls never discount. Rank and world-event multipliers stack after specialty increments.

pages.title: Dialogue
pages.text: Regional merchant/steward trees cover Tiannan, North, Chaotic Sea, Great Jin, Spirit Realm and Yin Underworld. Named sect stewards open their own halls. Menu actions require live tokens and anchors.
